Title: Baby Sensory Kildare & Carlow
Description:
Baby Sensory is an award-winning, research-based program for babies from birth to 13 months, designed to stimulate, educate, and support development through sensory experiences. Classes include activities like lights, music, bubbles, and massage to promote learning, movement, and bonding. These sessions also offer parents opportunities to connect, share experiences, and learn new, practical ideas to use at home.
Its a beautiful space where your baby can explore, learn and grow through gentle, magical sensory experiences. Each class is carefully designed to support your baby’s early learning and development, following their natural rhythm of play, rest, play. From colour and light to sound, movement and texture, every activity helps stimulate growing brains in a calm, nurturing way.
It’s also a special moment for you. A chance to slow down, connect with your baby, and meet other parents in a warm, welcoming environment where everyone understands those early months.
Classes held in Mondays in Carlow, Tuesdays in Newbridge & Thursdays in Naas.

Title: Art Room 109
Tagline: Sensory Art Class for Parents & Toddlers Ages 1-5
Description:
Play and Create by Art Room 109
Classes are designed for parents and walking toddlers aged 1 to 5. These 60-minute sessions are flexible to fit your little one’s routine—arrive and leave at a time that suits you. The final 10 minutes feature bubbles, music, and parachute play.
Each session is thoughtfully crafted to engage both parents and toddlers in a fun and dynamic way. With up to six different open-ended art stations, this is a completely child-led class focused on play-based learning and the development of fine motor, social, and creative skills. Parents must accompany and supervise their child throughout, as classes are fully child-led with no formal teaching—my role is to guide and facilitate creativity.
All sensory materials are freshly homemade, natural, and taste-safe. Washable, non-toxic paints are used, and we recommend dressing children in pre-loved clothes. These laid-back sessions encourage connection with other parents and the community while inspiring simple creative play you can try at home.
Based in Kinvara, Co. Galway, Art Room 109 travels up to one hour from H91 N5P2 to bring creative workshops to schools, community centres, and private venues.

Title: Bump Birth & Beyond
Tagline: Mum and Baby Yoga with Linda
Description:
What is Parent & Baby Yoga?
First off I am opening up this class to the non birthing parent.. In 2023 my husband was lucky enough to receive the 26 weeks paid paternity in his job and we had a wonderful 7 months together. He joined me in my mum & baby yoga class with the permission of my mums and it made me realise that there's less options for the non birthing partner who may work full time during the week so doing it on a Sunday morning.
The focus of the class is on movements and breathing specifically tailored for new moms. The babies benefit from the bonding time with mom, baby massages and the stimulating environment of new baby friends & OF COURSE HAVE LOTS FUN!!!!
Special attention is placed on developing core strength and stability – involving a particular emphasis on strengthening the back, abdomen and pelvic floor, as well as relieving tension in areas such as the neck, shoulders and back.
Previous yoga experience is not necessary to fully benefit from the classes, and women who have practiced yoga before will find these classes are a great way to transition back to their pre-pregnancy practice.
It is a good idea to wait for about 6 – 8 weeks after the delivery of your baby before attending class. If you had a caesarian birth this time should be extended to about 10 weeks, or until you receive the go-ahead from your doctor.
There is absolutely no problem with joining the class after the session has begun (space permitting), the movements are simple and it is easy to catch on.
Parent & Baby Yoga - 9:30am-10.30am Sundays

Title: Brick Buddies - Lego Club - Swords
Description:
The LEGO-based, neurodiversity friendly groups are specifically designed to aid, teach, and promote social communications and help children practice the skills that are usually the most challenging, in a safe and welcoming environment. The groups are facilitated by a Clinical Psychologist/Play Therapist and a Psychotherapist, helping to boost social skills and confidence for children on the autism spectrum (with low support needs), ADHD/ADD, anxiety, or communication challenges.
The upcoming term will host 2 groups - one group for children age 6 - 8 years and another group for children 9 - 12 years. The groups are held at the Holywell Community Centre, Swords, Co. Dublin and will run every Monday for a period of 10 weeks.
The groups will be attended by children only, so parents can have some time away while their children have fun, practice, and learn practical life skills.
Group information:
Group size: 6-8 children per group.
Duration: 10 weeks | 1 class per week - 60min long.
Starting: Monday 11th November 2024
Group 1 times:
Age 6-8 every Monday from 4pm to 5pm.
Group 2 times:
Age 9-12 every Monday from 5.30pm to 6.30pm.
There will be a short initial meeting (before beginning 10-week term) with a small number of children and facilitators to ensure the groups will be suitable and beneficial to your child. High enjoyment and interest in LEGO is highly needed.
Food is not permitted inside the room and during the class to ensure a comfortable environment for everyone. We recommend your child to bring some water with them. If needed, ear defenders are welcome too!

Title: Fingal Additional Needs
Description:
Fingal Additional Needs is a fun and inclusive experience for children with additional needs! Spaces are limited, so book your spot today!
Location: The Band Room, Skerries
My name is David, and I started Fingal Additional Needs after leaving my previous job. Many parents asked me to continue supporting their loved ones with 1-1 outings, and as a parent of a child with ASD and ADHD, I know how valuable a break can be.
For over 10 years, I've worked with children and adults with additional needs. After a successful year offering 1-1 support and two years running Football4All with Skerries Town, I introduced summer camps that were a huge success, leading to extra classes. I've recently set up an afterschool class.
My goal is to give parents and carers a well-deserved break, while providing a fun and engaging environment for children. I'm not a therapist, but I focus on creating meaningful and enjoyable experiences for the kids. Whether it's getting active or socializing or just happy to be in there own space these sessions are designed with your child's needs in mind, whether they have ADHD, autism, Down syndrome, or other additional needs.
You can check out some of the work I’ve done on Instagram and Facebook @fingaladditionalneeds.

Ready to Give Your Child a Kickstart in Life? ⚽️🎉
Join over 100,000 children every week in the World’s No. 1 Preschool Football Program, where we mix fun, learning, and football to build essential life skills from the very beginning! Our play-based classes are designed to inspire a love of sport, boost confidence, and foster early development—while having a blast!

👶 Junior Kickers (2.5 - 3.5 years)
Independence begins here! Kids start to participate more on their own, with parents close by for support. Our Play, Practice, and Understand method makes learning fun.

Children participate independently, with parents cheering from the sidelines. Skills and understanding deepen as we prepare for the next level.
⚽️ Mega Kickers (5 - 8 years)
This is where it all comes together! With a 20-minute match at the end of each session, children experience structured play and prepare for the step-up to football academies.
Throughout all stages, our Play Not Push philosophy encourages children to participate at their own pace, building confidence and making football fun!
With 33 venues across Dublin and Meath, there’s a Little Kickers class waiting for your child. Let’s kickstart their sporting journey today!

Title: Little Kickers Dublin South & Wicklow
Tagline: Preschool Football Program ages 18 months to 8
Description:
Join the World's No. 1 Preschool Football Program and join over 100,000 children participating every week.
Our play orientated classes are fun, engaging and nurture a love of sport from an early age.
We are proud to be More Than Just Football and while football is the tool we use our goal ism to develop
- the Fundamental of Movement (balance, agility & coordination)
- Fundamental Movement skills ( running, hopping, skipping, jumping)
- Social skills such as listening, sharing, taking turns
- Early Learning concepts like numbers, colours, body parts
We have 4 different age groups to ensure children participate with their peers in and around the same development level.
Our Little Kicks program is suitable for children aged 18 months to 2.5. It is a parent toddler program and active parental participation is required. This ensures your child gets the very best out of the sessions.
Learning to learn is the goal at this level so learning to listen, learning to follow instructions and our engaging fun games facilitate this.
Our Junior Kickers classes are for 2.5 to 3.5 year olds. Children are starting to get more independent at this stage. Parents will see them participating more by themselves however many will still like to have their parents close to them at the magic wall. Play, Practice, Understand is the learning outcome at this level.
The next stage in the program is the Mighty Kickers suitable for 3.5 to 5 year olds. Most children participate independently in these classes with parents encouraged to support from the sidelines. Our Play, Practice, Understand is further developed in this stage.
The Mega Kickers program brings together all the learning outcomes from the previous levels. There is a big step up with the classes relying less on the play orientated structure of the earlier stages and with a 20 minute match at the end of each session it's preparing children to move onto football academies and continue their football journey
Throughout all stages our core philosophy of Play not Push is embodied. We believe children should be gently encouraged to participate and allowed to watch if they are unsure. We hope that by seeing the other children in the class participating they will be spurred on to join in the fun.

Fun, immersive Spanish sessions where toddlers and children (18 months - 10 years) learn naturally through play, music and storytelling. No Spanish needed.

At Palabritas, children learn Spanish in a natural and playful way, just like they learn their first language.
Our sessions are designed for:
- Families who want to introduce Spanish from an early age
- Parents raising multilingual children
- Families where Spanish is already present at home and want a space to practise and strengthen it
🌍 Spanish is the second most spoken language in the world, and learning it early opens the door to communication, culture and connection.
All sessions are led by a native Spanish speaker, qualified in Early Childhood Education, with extensive experience in second language acquisition.
Through play, children:
- Build confidence in communication
- Develop listening and understanding skills
- Connect with language through real-life experiences
- Explore culture in a fun and meaningful way

Title: Summer Swimming Camps for Children
Tagline: 3-day swim camps for kids 5+ in Dalkey
Description:
SwimCamp is offers intensive swimming camps for children throughout the year at Castle Park School Swimming Pool in Dalkey, Dublin. These camps are designed for kids aged 5 and up who have some previous swimming experience. The classes usually lasting 45 minutes each day.
The camps are divided into three skill levels (Group 1, 2, and 3) to accommodate different abilities, from beginners to more advanced swimmers. There are also special clinics for teens aged 13+.
Children can be accompanied by any caregiver - parents, grandparents, or childminders. However, the website doesn't specify whether caregivers are required to stay for the duration of the class. It's best to contact SwimCamp directly for clarification on this point.
Regarding what to bring or wear, the website doesn't provide specific information. Typically for swim classes, children should bring:
A well-fitting swimsuit
A towel
Goggles (if preferred)
A swim cap (if required by the pool)
It's advisable to contact SwimCamp for any specific requirements or recommendations they might have for their classes.
Each camp consists of three 45-minute sessions held on consecutive days. The camps focus on improving existing swimming skills, building confidence in the water, and teaching water safety. Experienced, certified coaches lead small groups to ensure personalized attention.
SwimCamp emphasizes a fun and engaging learning environment while helping children develop essential swimming strokes, strength, and endurance. The camps are priced at €65 for the three-day session. Parents interested in enrolling their children can choose from multiple dates and time slots throughout July and August.

Title: Buggy Buddies Exercise Classes in Galway
Tagline: Outdoor group postnatal exercise classes in Galway
Description:
Buggy Buddies is a friendly, supportive physical activity programme for women with babies and young children who want to return to exercise safely after having a baby. Delivered by Galway Sports Partnership, these classes are free or low‑cost and take place weekly in indoor and outdoor community settings across Galway.
Classes are led by qualified and experienced postnatal tutors and are designed to be family‑friendly, with no need for childcare. Babies and toddlers can come along in their buggies and be part of the class, making it easier for parents to take time for their own wellbeing.
Each session includes a gentle mix of:
Light cardiovascular exercise
Breathing and relaxation techniques
Pelvic floor exercises
Postnatal strength and mobility work
All exercises are tailored to support postnatal recovery, helping participants build confidence, strength and fitness at their own pace. While the main focus is on postnatal wellbeing, childcarers and parents are also welcome to take part.
Buggy Buddies also supports social connection. A WhatsApp group is set up for each programme, giving participants the opportunity to stay in touch, share support and arrange walks or meet‑ups once the programme has finished.
Buggy Buddies is funded by the HSE and Women in Sport through Sport Ireland.

Title: Galway Community Circus
Tagline: Circus classes for toddlers, families, & youth
Description:
Galway Community Circus was created to meet the needs of our local youth by offering a non-competitive, physical and creative activity in a safe and welcoming space. Our philosophy is ‘circus for all’, and we use the circus arts to teach young people, including those who are disadvantaged, at-risk and vulnerable, the tools to develop self-confidence, resilience and social skills while tapping into strengths and hidden talents. Circus classes offer something for everyone to enjoy and are suitable for all ages, levels and abilities.
At Galway Community Circus, we offer multiple classes for ages 1-17 years (and adults 18+ too!) Our main location is in Shantalla on Galway's Westside, but we also offer classes in Renmore on Galway's Eastside as well as in Tuam.
We offer Toddler Circus classes for ages 1-4 years with an adult on Mondays, Thursdays and Saturdays in Shantalla and on Fridays in Renmore. In our Toddler Circus classes, adults are welcome to participate, but are not required, however they must stay in the class. We offer Family Circus classes in Shantalla on Saturdays for ages 4+ with siblings who can be younger or older. Adults are expected to participate in this class - a fun activity for the whole family! We also offer tea, coffee and social time before and after our Toddler and Family Circus classes.
Our Youth Circus programme features weekly classes for different age groups: 5-7 years, 8-11 years, 12-17 years. In these classes, parents/caregivers are not allowed to stay in the class. At our Shantalla location, we offer youth circus classes for ages 1-17 years. At our Renmore location, we offer youth circus classes for ages 1-12 years, and at our Tuam location we offer classes for ages 5-12 years.
All our classes run alongside the school year from September to June at different days throughout the week, depending on the class you choose. We also offer week-long summer camps by different age groups.
Participants in classes should wear comfortable clothes, bring a water bottle and wear grippy socks if they have them.
Classes vary in price based on the age group and length of the class. For 9 months of classes, classes are paid for via a monthly "subscription" fee. Some classes offer trials.
You can check out all our classes at https://www.galwaycommunitycircus.com/

Title: Little Kickers Galway
Tagline: Join the World's No. 1 Preschool Football Program
Description:
Join the World's No. 1 Preschool Football Program and join over 100,000 children participating every week.
Our play orientated classes are fun, engaging and nurture a love of sport from an early age.
We are proud to be More Than Just Football and while football is the tool we use our goal ism to develop
- the Fundamental of Movement (balance, agility & coordination)
- Fundamental Movement skills ( running, hopping, skipping, jumping)
- Social skills such as listening, sharing, taking turns
- Early Learning concepts like numbers, colours, body parts
We have 4 different age groups to ensure children participate with their peers in and around the same development level.
Our Little Kicks program is suitable for children aged 18 months to 2.5. It is a parent toddler program and active parental participation is required. This ensures your child gets the very best out of the sessions.
Learning to learn is the goal at this level so learning to listen, learning to follow instructions and our engaging fun games facilitate this.
Our Junior Kickers classes are for 2.5 to 3.5 year olds. Children are starting to get more independent at this stage. Parents will see them participating more by themselves however many will still like to have their parents close to them at the magic wall. Play, Practice, Understand is the learning outcome at this level.
The next stage in the program is the Mighty Kickers suitable for 3.5 to 5 year olds. Most children participate independently in these classes with parents encouraged to support from the sidelines. Our Play, Practice, Understand is further developed in this stage.
The Mega Kickers program brings together all the learning outcomes from the previous levels. There is a big step up with the classes relying less on the play orientated structure of the earlier stages and with a 20 minute match at the end of each session it's preparing children to move onto football academies and continue their football journey
Throughout all stages our core philosophy of Play not Push is embodied. We believe children should be gently encouraged to participate and allowed to watch if they are unsure. We hope that by seeing the other children in the class participating they will be spurred on to join in the fun.

Title: Little Kickers Kildare
Description:
Join the World's No. 1 Preschool Football Program and join over 100,000 children participating every week.
Our play orientated classes are fun, engaging and nurture a love of sport from an early age.
We are proud to be More Than Just Football and while football is the tool we use our goal ism to develop
- the Fundamental of Movement (balance, agility & coordination)
- Fundamental Movement skills ( running, hopping, skipping, jumping)
- Social skills such as listening, sharing, taking turns
- Early Learning concepts like numbers, colours, body parts
We have 4 different age groups to ensure children participate with their peers in and around the same development level.
Our Little Kicks program is suitable for children aged 18 months to 2.5. It is a parent toddler program and active parental participation is required. This ensures your child gets the very best out of the sessions.
Learning to learn is the goal at this level so learning to listen, learning to follow instructions and our engaging fun games facilitate this.
Our Junior Kickers classes are for 2.5 to 3.5 year olds. Children are starting to get more independent at this stage. Parents will see them participating more by themselves however many will still like to have their parents close to them at the magic wall. Play, Practice, Understand is the learning outcome at this level.
The next stage in the program is the Mighty Kickers suitable for 3.5 to 5 year olds. Most children participate independently in these classes with parents encouraged to support from the sidelines. Our Play, Practice, Understand is further developed in this stage.
The Mega Kickers program brings together all the learning outcomes from the previous levels. There is a big step up with the classes relying less on the play orientated structure of the earlier stages and with a 20 minute match at the end of each session it's preparing children to move onto football academies and continue their football journey
Throughout all stages our core philosophy of Play not Push is embodied. We believe children should be gently encouraged to participate and allowed to watch if they are unsure. We hope that by seeing the other children in the class participating they will be spurred on to join in the fun.

Title: Twinkle Kids Music & Movement
Description:
WHERE?
Naas, Co. Kildare | Tuesdays 10-10:50am
Little & Bright Stars is a 45-minute music and movement class for babies, wobblers, and toddlers. Using child-friendly music, movement-based songs, props, and imaginative play, children explore rhythm, movement, and their senses in a warm, playful environment.
Classes support early development including language, motor skills, coordination, creativity, confidence, and social interaction, while also strengthening the bond between child and carer. Sessions are relaxed and inclusive, with children encouraged to join in at their own pace.
What to bring:
A mat to sit on (optional) and a blanket or towel for babies.
Location:
Church of the Irish Martyrs, Ballycane, Naas
Parents and carers stay with their child. All are welcome!
What are Music & Movement classes?
These classes are playful, sensory-rich sessions designed to support early development through song, movement, rhythm, and connection. Using familiar songs, gentle actions, props, and free movement, children explore music in a way that feels joyful and natural.
What age are the classes suitable for?
Classes are suitable for babies, toddlers, and preschoolers aged 0–4 years. Activities are open-ended and adaptable, allowing each child to engage at their own developmental stage.
Do parents or carers stay with their child?
Yes. These are parent-and-child classes, with adults actively involved alongside their child, supporting connection, confidence, and shared enjoyment.
What skills does my child develop?
Music & Movement supports physical coordination, balance, language development, listening skills, social interaction, and emotional regulation. It also nurtures confidence and a love of music and movement from an early age.
Does my child need to participate the whole time?
Not at all. Children are welcome to observe, move freely, or join in when they feel ready. There is no pressure to perform or take part in a specific way.
What should we bring?
Comfortable clothing for both adult and child is ideal.Non-slip socks are recommended. All props and resources are provided.
Who leads the class?
Classes are led by Katie, an experienced early years educator with a background in children’s yoga, music, and movement, creating a warm, inclusive space for both children and carers.
Categories: Music, Movement & Play, Baby & Toddler Group

Address: Naas, County Kildare, Ireland

Who Can Attend?
Any primary caregiver is welcome — mum, dad, grandparents, guardians, or trusted caregivers.
Siblings can attend if the class allows, please send me a message to confirm.

Yes. Caregivers must stay for the full duration of the class to support their baby, join in with activities, and ensure safety.

Comfortable clothing suitable for movement and sensory play

Title: Bumps & Bainne Baby Massage Classes
Tagline: Connect with your baby through gentle massage
Description:
Join Aoife for a gentle and nurturing baby massage course designed to help you bond with your baby while learning a valuable skill that can support relaxation, sleep, digestion and communication.
Over the course, you will learn a full baby massage routine, techniques to help with common discomforts such as wind and constipation, and how massage can support your baby's emotional and physical wellbeing. Classes are baby-led, relaxed and welcoming, with plenty of time for feeding, cuddles and nappy changes whenever needed.
As well as learning massage techniques, you'll have the opportunity to connect with other parents and caregivers in a supportive environment.
Thursdays 10-10.45am
Redeemer Family Resource Centre, Dundalk
Baby massage classes are suitable for babies from approximately 6 weeks of age until they become actively mobile.
Mums, dads, grandparents and other primary caregivers are welcome to attend with baby. One adult attends with each baby.
This is a caregiver-and-baby class, and the attending adult must remain with their baby for the full duration of the session.
Please bring:
* A towel or blanket for your baby to lie on
* Any feeding supplies you may need
* Nappies and wipes
* A spare change of clothes for baby
Babies should wear comfortable clothing that is easy to remove for massage. Massage oil will be provided.
Please don't worry if your baby sleeps, feeds, cries or needs extra cuddles during class. Baby massage is always baby-led, and you're welcome to follow your baby's cues throughout the session.
I look forward to welcoming you and your baby for a relaxed and enjoyable experience together.

Title: Adventure Avenue Ltd
Description:
Adventure Avenue Ltd is a vibrant, purpose-built children’s role play and learning centre located in Ashbourne, Co. Meath, Ireland.

Title: Baby Sensory Meath (Ashbourne)
Tagline: Research backed classes to stimulate development
Description:
Have you ever seen a baby's eyes light up with wonder and excitement? That's the magic of Baby Sensory classes every single week!
Baby Sensory, Toddler Sense and Hello Baby founder, Dr. Lin Day (PhD., M. Phil., PGCE., FETC., BSc., Dip Ed.) is one of the UK's leading parenting experts. We're proud to say that Baby Sensory is backed by over 35 years of research in childhood learning and development.
Each Baby Sensory Meath class is a carefully curated experience, blending a variety of themes and activities that are designed to captivate your baby's attention and engage their senses. From sensory play and music to movement and visual stimulation, our classes are a delightful mix of exploration and learning. With a new theme each week, you and your baby will embark on a different adventure every time you attend, ensuring that no two classes are ever the same for your entire Baby Sensory journey.
The benefits of attending Baby Sensory extend far beyond what we do in class. By participating in our classes, you can support your baby's cognitive and motor development, enhance their socialisation skills, and forge a stronger emotional bond between you and your baby. Our classes are not just about creating a fun experience; they are an essential tool for nurturing your baby's growth and development during their formative months.
The best part is that every activity we do together is backed by research to ensure it supports your baby's development, as well as being lots of fun! So you can relax and enjoy the classes together, safe in the knowledge that you are giving your baby the very best start in their sensory journey.
Classes take place weekly in Ashbourne, Navan and Dunshaughlin. Each baby must be accompanied by a caregiver at all times.
Ages Detail: 0-6 months, 6-12 months
Address: Rath, County Meath, A84 KR91, Ireland

Title: Bloom Baby Classes North East Ireland
Description:
Bloom Baby have two classes on offer:
🐛 Caterpillar Club (Birth - 6 months) 🐛
A gentle and calm introduction to our musical sensory classes. Activities designed to aid all areas of baby development, with a strong focus on parent and baby bonding. Our Caterpillar club class awakens baby's first senses and stimulates in a fun, yet soothing way, using music, sensory props and lights. Title: Boyne Babies
Tagline: Sensory play sessions for babies and parents
Description:
At Boyne Babies we create a welcoming space where babies learn through sensory play, and parents connect through community. Each weekly session is thoughtfully designed to support your baby’s early development through music, movement, lights, textures, and gentle sensory exploration. Every week features a new theme to keep things fresh, fun, and engaging — helping your little one discover new experiences while building important cognitive and physical milestones.
Time & Location:
🕚 Wednesdays, 11:00 AM – 12:00 PM
📍 Julianstown Community Centre, A92 D250
Who Can Attend:
These classes are open to babies aged 0–13 months and their caregivers — whether that’s mum, dad, grandparents, or another loved one. Everyone is welcome to join and share in the experience.
Caregiver Attendance:
Yes, caregivers are required to stay for the duration of the class. Each session is designed to be enjoyed together — helping you bond with your baby while connecting with other local parents and carers in a relaxed, supportive environment.
What to Bring / Wear:
Babies should wear comfortable clothing that allows easy movement and play. You may want to bring:
A small blanket or muslin for your baby to sit or lie on
A change bag with nappies, wipes, and a bottle or snack if needed
A spare outfit, as sensory play can sometimes get a little messy!

Title: Little Kickers
Description:
Join the World's No. 1 Preschool Football Program and join over 100,000 children participating every week.
Our play orientated classes are fun, engaging and nurture a love of sport from an early age.
We are proud to be More Than Just Football and  while football is the tool we use our goal ism to develop
- the Fundamental of Movement (balance, agility & coordination)
- Fundamental Movement skills ( running, hopping, skipping, jumping)
- Social skills such as listening, sharing, taking turns
- Early Learning concepts like numbers, colours, body parts
We have 4 different age groups to ensure children participate with their peers in and around the same development level.
Our Little Kicks program is suitable for children aged 18 months to 2.5. It is a parent toddler program and active parental participation is required. This ensures your child gets the very best out of the sessions.
Learning to learn is the goal at this level so learning to listen, learning to follow instructions and our engaging fun games facilitate this.
Our Junior Kickers classes are for 2.5 to 3.5 year olds. Children are starting to get more independent at this stage. Parents will see them participating more by themselves however many will still like to have their parents close to them at the magic wall. Play, Practice, Understand is the learning outcome at this level.
The next stage in the program is the Mighty Kickers suitable for 3.5 to 5 year olds. Most children participate independently in these classes with parents encouraged to support from the sidelines. Our Play, Practice, Understand is further developed in this stage.
The Mega Kickers program brings together all the learning outcomes from the previous levels. There is a big step up with the classes relying less on the play orientated structure of the earlier stages and with a 20 minute match at the end of each session it's preparing children to move onto football academies and continue their football journey
Throughout all stages our core philosophy of Play not Push is embodied. We believe children should be gently encouraged to participate and allowed to watch if they are unsure. We hope that by seeing the other children in the class participating they will be spurred on to join in the fun.

Description:

Toddle On play café is a warm, welcoming space where babies and young children can play, explore and learn while parents and carers can relax and connect. Play space is suitable for 0-10 year olds. We offer themed sensory and messy play classes for children aged 2 months to 6 years, designed to support early development through music, movement, storytelling and hands-on play.

Want to know more about the play space? Our play café consists of your rooms:
🌈 Sensory Play Room
A calm, engaging space designed especially for babies and toddlers. This room features soft play, lights, textures and sensory toys that encourage early development, curiosity and gentle exploration in a relaxed environment.

Perfect for little imaginations, this room allows children to role-play and create their own adventures. From pretend play to dressing up and themed setups, it supports social skills, confidence and creative thinking. A comfortable, welcoming area for parents and carers to relax while keeping an eye on their little ones. Enjoy a coffee, chat with other parents and take a breather while your children play safely nearby.
🎨 Creative & Messy Play Classroom
A hands-on space where children are encouraged to explore, create and get messy. This room supports fine motor skills and learning through play — without the mess at home!
🎯Games Room
The Games Room offers older children a dedicated space to enjoy a mix of active games and imaginative play. From basketball, mini snooker and football to creative play with Barbie, Paw Patrol, superheroes, puppets and dress-up, this room keeps older siblings happily engaged.
Our Classes
Toddle On Teenies
Nurture your bond with your baby through our Toddle On Teenies program. With baby sensory activities, baby beats, lámh and baby massage, you and your little one will create lasting memories while supporting your baby's development.
Toddle On Tinies
Bond with your growing baby at Toddle On with our Toddle On Tinies program. Explore the world of baby sensory, lámh, messy play and music, using instruments to engage with your little one and bond over a weekly theme. Create lasting memories with your baby at Toddle On.
Toddle On Tots
Let your tot unleash their artistic imagination at Toddle On with our Toddle on Tots program. Each week, your child will delve into a new theme while learning a new sound, exploring messy play, role play, stories, numeracy, lámh, music, and crafts. Watch your tot develop and grow while having fun in a welcoming and engaging environment.
Based in DB fitness and injuries, Unit 5 Pinewood Business Park (beside Lidl in Clonard). Various times depending on child’s age, please see booking page for times. When you book a play session you can drop in anytime that day within the opening hours.  All caregivers welcome, required to stay for duration. All resources provided, refreshments available to purchase. Sibling discounts and memberships available.
For baby classes advised to have easily accessible outfit for baby massage. For older classes messy play involved so best not to wear a new outfit.
Got a birthday coming up? Have full use of the play space and a bubble disco for the amazing price of €100 and have your party with us. Snack bags available to purchase to use as your party bags.

Description:
Step into a world of outdoor wonderment as we invite you and your little ones to join our enchanting nature-inspired playgroups at Twinkle Kids! Designed for children aged 0-4 years old, our playgroups promise to ignite their curiosity, imagination, and love for the great outdoors.
What to Expect:
🌿 Themed Mud Kitchen: Let your tiny chefs get their hands dirty as they whip up mud pies, create culinary masterpieces, and explore the delightful messiness of mud play.
🏖️ Sand Area: Dig, build, and discover in our sandy paradise, where your little architects can construct sandcastles and embark on sandy adventures.

Notes for Parents:
Please ensure your child wears appropriate clothing. We will be outdoors exposed to the elements so please wear appropriate raingear/sunscreen/sun hat and bring a change of clothes for your child. A towel is also advised.
Snacks are allowed at outdoor play but PLEASE bring all rubbish home and watch out for falling snacks! We like to leave no trace and protect nature as best we can :)

Parents /guardians must supervise their children at all times.
